product_models_sale_terms_check.name: product_models_sale_terms_check
product_models_sale_terms_check.value: ("product_models"."warranty_type" is null or "product_models"."warranty_type" in ('none', 'seller', 'factory')) and ("product_models"."warranty_days" is null or "product_models"."warranty_days" between 1 and 3650) and ("product_models"."made_to_order_days" is null or "product_models"."made_to_order_days" between 1 and 60)

supplier_products_model_combination_chec.name: supplier_products_model_combination_check
supplier_products_model_combination_chec.value: ("supplier_products"."model_id" is null and "supplier_products"."color" is null and "supplier_products"."size" is null and "supplier_products"."variant_attributes" = '{}'::jsonb and "supplier_products"."variant_fiscal" = '{}'::jsonb) or ("supplier_products"."model_id" is not null and ("supplier_products"."color" is not null or "supplier_products"."size" is not null))

supplier_products_sale_terms_check.name: supplier_products_sale_terms_check
supplier_products_sale_terms_check.value: ("supplier_products"."warranty_type" is null or "supplier_products"."warranty_type" in ('none', 'seller', 'factory')) and ("supplier_products"."warranty_days" is null or "supplier_products"."warranty_days" between 1 and 3650) and ("supplier_products"."made_to_order_days" is null or "supplier_products"."made_to_order_days" between 1 and 60)

suppliers_catalog_owner_check.name: suppliers_catalog_owner_check
suppliers_catalog_owner_check.value: ("suppliers"."catalog_kind" = 'supplier' and "suppliers"."owner_tenant_id" is null) or ("suppliers"."catalog_kind" = 'seller' and "suppliers"."owner_tenant_id" is not null and "suppliers"."organization_id" is null)

supplier_flags_revoke_check.name: supplier_flags_revoke_check
supplier_flags_revoke_check.value: ("supplier_flags"."revoked_at" is null and "supplier_flags"."revoke_note" is null) or ("supplier_flags"."revoked_at" is not null and "supplier_flags"."revoke_note" is not null and btrim("supplier_flags"."revoke_note") <> '' and char_length("supplier_flags"."revoke_note") <= 500)

return_claims_credit_check.name: return_claims_credit_check
return_claims_credit_check.value: "return_claims"."supplier_cost_cents" >= 0 and ("return_claims"."credited_cents" is null or "return_claims"."credited_cents" between 1 and "return_claims"."supplier_cost_cents")

return_claims_shipping_check.name: return_claims_shipping_check
return_claims_shipping_check.value: ("return_claims"."return_shipping_cents" is null or "return_claims"."return_shipping_cents" >= 0) and ("return_claims"."supplier_owes_shipping_cents" is null or "return_claims"."supplier_owes_shipping_cents" >= 0)

platform_settings_payment_before_prepari.name: platform_settings_payment_before_preparing_check
platform_settings_payment_before_prepari.value: "platform_settings"."payment_before_preparing_since" is null or "platform_settings"."require_receiving_account_since" is not null

shipment_payments_refund_idx.name: shipment_payments_refund_idx
shipment_payments_refund_idx.where: "shipment_payments"."status" = 'approved' and "shipment_payments"."refund_failed_at" is null and "shipment_payments"."refund_held_at" is null

shipment_payments_held_idx.name: shipment_payments_held_idx
shipment_payments_held_idx.where: "shipment_payments"."status" in ('approved','charged_back') and "shipment_payments"."released_at" is null and "shipment_payments"."refund_failed_at" is null
